prediction_interval.description: For each zone and horizon, compute residuals from best model's validation predictions. PI half-width = 1.28 * sample_std(residuals). Applied symmetrically to forecasts.

es_state_leakage_prevention: Exponential smoothing model is rebuilt fresh (state reset) for each independent evaluation (every horizon, every zone). The nonlocal 'last' variable is scoped inside make_es() and is not shared across separate factory() calls.
